description: Full-text search of artists by name and biography, optionally narrowed by birth city/country and by a year the artist was alive (born <= year <= died, or born + 80 years when the death year is unknown). Returns pk, artist_name, url, image_url (absolute URL of the large artist portrait, null when there is none), city, country, date_born, date_death and score.

alive_in_year.description: Optional year the artist was alive, e.g. 1503.

language.description: Site language code (2 letters, e.g. "en", "fr"). Default "en".

query.description: Artist name or words from the biography.

name: search_artists
title: Search artists
